mapper.sql: id, username, email, password_hash, role, status, last_login_time, last_login_ip, login_attempts, locked_until, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, last_login_time = #{lastLoginTime}, last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, login_attempts = #{loginAttempts}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET status = 'LOCKED', locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET status = 'ACTIVE', locked_until = NULL, login_attempts = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = #{role}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = #{status}
